programme.title: Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani
programme.desc: Prem, a free-spirited boy, falls in love with a young girl Jenny. However, when he learns that she is in love with her college sweetheart, Rahul, Prem sacrifices his love and helps Jenny to get married to the love of her life.

programme.title: Karle Pyaar Karle
programme.desc: Childhood friends Kabir and Preet are rebels. They play a game that results in crime, because of which Kabir and his mother have to leave the town. Twelve years later the friends reunite but Preet believes they must maintain distance.

programme.title: Chalta Hai Yaar
programme.desc: Namdev, a man who supplies material for dead people's last rites, is frustrated with being mistreated by his wife and judged by society. When he attempts suicide, a restless soul saves his life and helps him to win back his dignity.

programme.title: Daata
programme.desc: Kundan loses his father and sister to the unjust and inhuman practice of dowry. Seeking revenge, he commits a murder, and his life spirals downwards from then on.

programme.title: Rajkumar
programme.desc: Two warring kingdoms Thambore and Araavali decide to end their enmity by marrying their children. But post a fateful incidence the kingdoms revert to rivalry. Now Araavali prince's love for Thambore's princess is their only hope to end the rivalry.

programme.title: Auzaar
programme.desc: Suraj, a CBI officer, learns that his childhood friend Yash and his father run an illegal business. He is assigned to investigate Yash, but he decides to convince Yash to mend his ways.

programme.title: Aankhen
programme.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.
